crew.overview: NYPD cop John McClane's plan to reconcile with his estranged wife is thrown for a serious loop when, minutes after he arrives at her offices Christmas Party, the entire building is overtaken by a group of terrorists. With little help from the LAPD, wisecracking McClane sets out to single-handedly rescue the hostages and bring the bad guys down.
crew.title: Die Hard

crew.overview: Wrongfully convicted of murdering his wife and sentenced to death, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find the real killer and clear his name.
crew.title: The Fugitive

details.biography:
Jeb Stuart (born January 21, 1956) is an American screenwriter, film director, and producer known for writing blockbuster action films like Die Hard (1988) and The Fugitive (1993) and creating the Netflix television series Vikings: Valhalla (2022–2024).
